title: Learning Semantic Segmentation from Multiple Datasets with Label Shifts (UniSeg)
mechanism: Class-independent BCE removes gradient conflict between mismatched label spaces; an extra loss exploits cross-dataset class relationships.
evidence: Road scenes: more than +8 IoU on unseen KITTI, 39.4 IoU on WildDash2 zero-shot.
adaptation: Replace softmax CE with per-class BCE in the joint run; encode UCF crack_region as parent of {crack, inactive}. Judge on E1, since R gain is on unseen domains.
min_experiment: Arm: joint UCF+MSS run with per-class BCE, 30k steps, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed and the softmax joint arm. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and clean-49 crack IoU drops > 0.012. ~15 GPU-h.
